title: Demurrage and Detention Free Time: Recomputed Demurrage as a Ceiling on Goodwill
content:
## Clause

On a Demurrage and Detention Free Time record, goodwill is never given on demurrage that was overcharged. For this purpose the demurrage line is priced again from three sources only: the movement dates the terminal and depot recorded, the product the record carries, and the booking. The repricing follows exactly the method by which the record's final demurrage line is worked out. For a merged-clock export record, the repriced demurrage days are numbered onward from the chargeable days shown on the record's booked detention line.

## What the repricing uses

| Element | Separate clocks | Merged clock |
|---|---|---|
| clock that yields demurrage | import: discharge to full gate-out; export: full gate-in to loading | import: discharge to empty return; export: empty pickup to loading |
| free days compared | the product's demurrage free days for the direction | the product's merged free days for the direction |
| days that count as demurrage | all days of the demurrage clock beyond its free days | import: chargeable days on or before full gate-out; export: chargeable days after full gate-in |
| first slab position | the first demurrage day billed | import: the first chargeable day; export: one beyond the chargeable days on the booked detention line |

A day's slab is 1, 2, 3 or 4 according to whether its position lies within the first slab length, within the first two lengths together, within all three together, or beyond them. Every repriced day is priced at the demurrage rate belonging to its slab within the applicable rate class, adjusted for the booking's cargo type as the goodwill rules for cargo type require.

## The recomputed amount

The recomputed amount is the total of the repriced day rates, rounded to the cent once on the total.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A line invoiced at 1400.00 whose repricing from the recorded dates comes to 1250.00 carries 150.00 of overcharge, and goodwill is never measured on that 150.00. A line whose repricing comes to more than its invoiced amount carries no overcharge.
